label: Sidewall-grating distributed Bragg deflector (SGD): Si wire TE0 to in-plane Gaussian slab beam, MFD 30 um (x75 expander), SOI (design)
core_material: Si 260 nm (design slab thickness); Si wire with apodized blazed sidewall trenches (etch ratio set per element, minimum gap 50 nm), SWG bridge (period = half the grating period, duty cycle 0.5, W_SWG 2 um) and a 1.5 um GRIN SWG-to-slab adaptation into the unetched Si slab free-propagation region
notes: Design only (3D FDTD; p.10-11); the paper fabricates only the uniform partial deflector (separate row). Loss terms of the 2.15 dB: 1.87 dB out-of-plane radiation in the diffractive elements, 0.18 dB field mismatch, 0.1 dB residual transmission; 96 % overlap with the target Gaussian (p.10-11). Converts a 0.38 um MFD wire mode to a 30 um MFD slab beam (p.2-3); in-plane radiation angle -8.4 deg (p.8) and per-element diffraction efficiencies of 60-80 % (Fig. 7, p.8): no registry parameter for mode_converter (mfd_chip_um, emission_angle_deg not allowed), not entered. Back-to-back rows (m2, m3) use two of these SGDs facing each other (one rotated 180 deg, offset dz). Upper cladding present (Fig. 1 caption) but material / thickness not stated. The ~551 nm pitch (p.3) is an illustrative estimate for -5 deg, not the design pitch: not entered. Authors at U. Malaga, Bionand and NRC Canada; no fabrication for this design.
